title: orthopogon africanus
intro: Orthopogon africanus, commonly known as East African lemongrass, is a tropical grass native to East Africa and parts of Asia. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Orthopogon africanus include its anti-bacterial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-fungal properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Orthopogon africanus include essential oils such as citral, geraniol, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
